$Comment: What the Scarak Brood Queen pays when she falls, rolled once for every participant the fight
names this table under Loot.OnDefeat. Each roll a player wins is then kept with a chance equal
to their share of the fight, so the player who carried it keeps all three when they fire and a
latecomer keeps a little of what they rolled.
The first roll always fires: a handful of essence and something to drink on the walk home. The
second is a bar of the desert's own metal, better than even odds. The third is the rare one, a
skill boost token the player pockets and cracks whenever suits them (see
Server/ZiggfreedCommon/RewardKinds/Mmo_Boost_Token.json for its Params). Chance is a
percentage; retune the Counts and the Chances freely, each roll stands on its own. The quest
that sends a player after her pays separately, on hand-in.
Name: Mmo_Sands_Brood_Queen
